description: PAID ($0.0027 USDC via x402). ENS both ways: a name (vitalik.eth, or a Basename like jesse.base.eth) to its address, or an address to its primary name — which the Universal Resolver verifies resolves back — plus the profile records the name's owner published: url, X/Twitter, GitHub, description and the raw avatar record (not fetched). Read from Ethereum mainnet over public RPCs; Basenames resolve through ENS's off-chain lookup, whose gateway URLs are fetched through FiatDock's SSRF guard. ASCII names only (letters, digits, hyphens). A name with no address, or an address with no primary name, answers 404 and is not charged. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

address.description: Or an address, to find its primary ENS name (0x + 40 hex)

name.description: An ENS name to resolve (vitalik.eth, jesse.base.eth …) — ASCII letters, digits and hyphens

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

name: ens_resolve

defaulted.description: Present only when the body was empty: which subject the answer is for, and why

isPrimaryName.description: True when the address's primary name is this name

note.description: What the records are, and the limits

primaryName.description: The address's own primary (reverse) name, verified to resolve back, or null

query.description: What was asked: a name or an address

records.description: Profile records the name's owner published (their words, unverified); avatar is the raw record and is not fetched

title: ENS & Basename resolver (both ways, with profile records) ($0.0027)
